hantawatta-: rule as king, exercise kingship (verb; written with the king sign REX)
kwari: if (conjunction; the corpus's gloss — where 'if' reads oddly, 'when' is a possible reading)
CAPUT-tti(ya/i)-: of a (noble)man — adjective formed with -iya- from CAPUT-tt(i)-, written with the head sign CAPUT; the corpus leaves the Luwian word open
i(ya)Ti-: delete, erase (verb; classified by the hand sign MANUS or the sign L69; the capital T marks a sound the spelling leaves open)
hilan(a)-: gate, gateway (noun; written with the gate sign PORTA) — the corpus also glosses it 'palace'
alunnazza-: covet (verb; classified by the heart sign COR, shown ▢ because no sign for it can be verified)
alunnamm(a)-: lust, covetousness (noun; classified by the heart sign COR, shown as ▢ because no sign for it can be verified)
attuwalastr(i)-: viciousness (abstract noun built on attuwal- 'bad', written with the sign MALUS)
haniyattastr(a/i)-: badness, wickedness (abstract noun; classified by MALUS₂, a 'bad' sign)
zadi: here (adverb; sounded zari, the d heard as r)
tazza-: stay, remain (verb; classified by the leg sign CRUS)
ar(i)-: time (noun; written with the syllabogram ara/i)
tippas-: sky, heaven (noun; written with the sky sign CAELUM) — also its possessive adjective tippasassis 'of heaven'
Tiwad-: Tiwazas — the Sun-god (divine name; classified by DEUS and written with the sun sign SOL; the d sounded z before the nominative -s)
I(ya)-: Iyas — a god (divine name; classified by DEUS; the corpus identifies him with Ea)
Arma-: Armas — the Moon-god (divine name; classified by DEUS and written with the moon sign LUNA)
hantawattahi(d)-: kingship, kingdom (abstract noun from hantawatti- 'king'; written with REX and the abstract suffix -hi(d)-)
-in: instrumental ending of a pronoun — 'with, by; from' (za- 'this': zin)
-ra: 3rd person singular past ending, active — '(he, she, it) …-ed' (-ta with its t sounded r)

__broaden__.-ha: 1st person singular past ending — 'I …-ed' · also the generalizing suffix of an indefinite pronoun — 'any-, some-' (kwis-ha 'anyone, someone')
__broaden__.-wi: dative ending — 'upon horse' · also, on verbs, the 1st person singular present ending, active — 'I …'
__broaden__.-tti: dative-locative ending — 'to, for, upon' · also, on verbs, the 3rd person singular present ending, active — '(he, she, it) …s'
__broaden__.-ri: instrumental ending — 'with, by means of' · also, on verbs, the 3rd person singular present ending, active — '(he, she, it) …s' (-di with its d sounded r)
__broaden__.kwi-: who, which (the relative pronoun, written with the REL sign or spelled kwa/i-) · also, with the suffix -ha, the indefinite 'any, anyone' (kwis-ha)
__broaden__.ahha: away, forth, utterly (the preverb ARHA — colors the verb like English 'out' in 'spread out') · also 'back' (the corpus glosses it 'away, back'); with a verb of deleting, 'erase'
__broaden__.CAPUT-tt(i)-: man, person — written with the head sign CAPUT; the corpus leaves the Luwian word open (§1 and §20 read the sign ziti-) · also '(noble)man' (so the corpus glosses it), a man of rank
__broaden__.anta: in, inside · also 'into', with a verb (as a preverb)
